sourceTitle: The Queen of the Savannah: A Story of the Mexican War
description: "The Queen of the Savannah: A Story of the Mexican War" by Gustave Aimard is a historical novel written in the mid-19th century. It explores themes of war, colonization, and the conflict between Mexicans and Indigenous peoples during the backdrop of the Mexican War.
